summary: The matrix contains at most 15 cells, so the complete remaining-one state space has at most 32768 masks; moreover every legal rectangular shape has at most three rows or at most three columns, preventing an honest deeper operation-order scaling trend.

workload_bound.source_constraint: the contract requires m*n at most 15, with every cell binary

replacement_checks.evidence: The memoized reference evaluates no more than 2^15 = 32768 masks and tests at most 15 legal cell choices per computed mask.

Regression compares exhaustive small binary matrices and deterministic legal 15-cell matrices against an independent bottom-up mask oracle, including zero, dense, sparse, asymmetric, single-row, and single-column boundaries.
